group.passage: Measles is one of the easiest diseases to catch. It is caused by a virus that spreads through the air when a sick person coughs or sneezes. The virus can stay in the air or on surfaces for up to two hours, and one sick person can pass it to as many as 18 others. The illness usually starts with a high fever, a runny nose, a cough, and red eyes. A few days later, a rash appears on the face and slowly moves down the body. Young children who have not been vaccinated face the greatest danger. The good news is that measles can be prevented. A vaccine has been in use since 1963, and it is safe, works well, and costs less than one US dollar per child. Doctors suggest that every child receive two doses, and in some countries the first dose is given when a baby is nine months old. Health experts estimate that measles vaccines saved about 59 million lives between 2000 and 2024. The chart below shows the share of children aged 12 to 23 months around the world who had received a measles vaccine. In 2018 and 2019, the share was above 86 percent. Then the COVID-19 pandemic arrived, and health services in many countries were badly disrupted. The share dropped to 83.9 percent in 2020 and fell even further in 2021. Experts called this the largest continued drop in childhood vaccination in about 30 years. Since then, the numbers have begun to bounce back: more children were vaccinated in 2022 than in the year before. By 2024, the share had climbed to 84.3 percent, but it was still lower than before the pandemic. Because measles spreads so easily, even a small drop can leave millions of children without protection. For this reason, health workers are still trying to reach every child who was missed.

第三段的圖表在呈現什麼的比例？
找能同時包含疾病、疫苗和近年變化的選項。

2.explanation_zh: 第一段第二句說麻疹病毒在病人咳嗽或打噴嚏時經由空氣傳播。
evidence: It is caused by a virus that spreads through the air when a sick person coughs or sneezes.

option_notes_zh.B: 文中沒有提到昆蟲叮咬。
option_notes_zh.C: 紅疹是麻疹的症狀，文中沒有說碰到紅疹會傳染。

2.strategy_zh: 題幹問 how ... spread，找文中 spreads 這個字所在的句子。
hints: 在第一段找 spreads 這個字。
病毒經由什麼傳播？在病人做什麼的時候？
coughs or sneezes 是咳嗽或打噴嚏。

3.explanation_zh: 冒號後面說明：2022 年接種的兒童比前一年多，所以 bounce back 是「開始回升、恢復」。下一句也說 2024 年比例爬升到 84.3%。
evidence: Since then, the numbers have begun to bounce back: more children were vaccinated in 2022 than in the year before.

option_notes_zh.A: 取 bounce「彈跳」的字面動作；文中說的是數字變化。
option_notes_zh.C: 和冒號後「2022 年接種人數比前一年多」相反。
option_notes_zh.D: 數字有增加，不是維持不變。

3.strategy_zh: 詞義題看冒號後面的說明，再代回原句確認。
hints: 找到最後一段粗體的 bounce back。
冒號後面說 2022 年接種的孩子比前一年多還是少？
數字「變多、回到原來的水準」叫做什麼？

4.explanation_zh: 圖中 2021 年是 82.0%，比 2018 年的 86.4%、2020 年的 83.9%、2024 年的 84.3% 都低，是七年中最低的一年。文中也說 2020 年之後「在 2021 年降得更低」。
evidence: The share dropped to 83.9 percent in 2020 and fell even further in 2021.

option_notes_zh.A: 2018 年是 86.4%，是圖中最高的一年。

4.strategy_zh: 找「最低」就是找折線最低的那一點，再讀它的年份；可以用資料表逐年比對。

translation_zh.text:
麻疹是最容易被傳染的疾病之一。它是由一種病毒引起的，當病人咳嗽或打噴嚏時，病毒會經由空氣傳播。這種病毒可以在空氣中或物體表面停留長達兩小時，而一個病人最多可以傳染給 18 個人。這種病通常一開始是發高燒、流鼻水、咳嗽和眼睛發紅。幾天後，臉上會出現紅疹，並慢慢往下蔓延到全身。沒有接種疫苗的幼兒面臨的危險最大。
好消息是，麻疹是可以預防的。麻疹疫苗從 1963 年就開始使用，它很安全、效果好，而且每個孩子的費用不到一美元。醫生建議每個孩子都接種兩劑，在一些國家，第一劑在嬰兒九個月大時接種。健康專家估計，在 2000 年到 2024 年之間，麻疹疫苗拯救了大約 5,900 萬條生命。
下面的圖表顯示全世界 12 到 23 個月大的兒童中，已經接種麻疹疫苗的比例。2018 年和 2019 年，這個比例都在 86% 以上。接著 COVID-19 疫情來襲，許多國家的醫療服務受到嚴重干擾。這個比例在 2020 年降到 83.9%，2021 年又降得更低。專家說，這是大約 30 年來兒童疫苗接種率最大的持續下降。
從那時起，數字開始回升：2022 年接種的兒童比前一年多。到了 2024 年，比例爬升到 84.3%，但仍然低於疫情之前。因為麻疹非常容易傳播，即使只是小小的下降，也可能讓數百萬名兒童失去保護。因此，醫護人員仍在努力找到每一個錯過接種的孩子。

checked.claim: Measles is one of the easiest diseases to catch; the virus spreads through the air when a sick person coughs or sneezes.（f1；WHO 事實單 2026-10-09 複查：highly contagious、airborne）
The virus can stay in the air or on surfaces for up to two hours, and one sick person can pass it to as many as 18 others.（f2、f3；WHO 原頁：up to two hours、up to 18 secondary infections）
The illness starts with a high fever, a runny nose, a cough, and red eyes; a few days later a rash appears on the face and moves down the body.（f4）
Young children who have not been vaccinated face the greatest danger.（f5）
A vaccine has been in use since 1963; it is safe, works well, and costs less than one US dollar per child.（f6；WHO 原頁：introduction of measles vaccine in 1963、costs less than US$ 1 per child）
Doctors suggest two doses; in some countries the first dose is given at nine months.（f7；WHO 原頁：9 months of age in countries where measles is common）
Measles vaccines saved about 59 million lives between 2000 and 2024.（f8；WHO 原頁：averted nearly 59 million deaths between 2000 and 2024）
The chart shows children aged 12 to 23 months who had received a measles vaccine.（f11）
In 2018 and 2019 the share was above 86 percent; it dropped to 83.9 percent in 2020 and fell further in 2021.（d1：86.42、86.23、83.88、82.04；World Bank API 2026-10-09 重抓一致）
Experts called this the largest continued drop in childhood vaccination in about 30 years.（f9）
More children were vaccinated in 2022 than in the year before; by 2024 the share had climbed to 84.3 percent, still lower than before the pandemic.（f10；d1：83.69 > 82.04、84.30 < 86.23）
